cento-e-oitenta-e-nove-mil-paginas.t: One hundred and eighty-nine thousand pages
cento-e-oitenta-e-nove-mil-paginas.s: Nobody will read it all. What can be known before opening the first one.

o-grafo-nao-acusa-ninguem.s: A reading manual for those who arrived thinking that a dot connected to another dot is evidence.

inq-5026-01-doze-bilhoes-e-duas-associac.s: A Central Bank letter in March 2025, a reply naming civil-servant associations in Bahia as the origin of R$ 6.7 billion in loans, and a shelf company renamed two days before signing the contract. Where Operation Compliance Zero began.

inq-5026-02-o-lado-do-brb.s: A state-owned bank that bought loan portfolios worth 30% of its own assets, breached its Basel ratio, accepted repayment in instalments against the contract and, according to the police, really just wanted to lend. What the record says about the buyer.

inq-5026-03-dezoito-de-novembro.s: Five pre-trial detentions, two temporary ones, a bank president removed, an order for the Central Bank to intervene in BRB and, the same day, the liquidation of Master. Then a flight to Dubai that became an argument, a court that said no and, ten days later, said yes.

inq-5026-04-o-parlamentar-na-gaveta.s: A document seized at a suspect's home, a complaint to the Supreme Court, a duty judge who suspended everything on a December night, a prosecutor who called it turmoil, and the inquiry that moved up anyway.

inq-5026-05-o-inquerito-vira-balcao.t: The inquiry becomes a service counter
inq-5026-05-o-inquerito-vira-balcao.s: Under the new reporting justice, from February 2026, Inquiry 5.026 starts receiving everything: invitations from the Senate, safe-conducts for the congressional inquiry committee, a former Central Bank governor who did not want to go, congressmen asking to include other congressmen, and the Central Bank flagging a second conglomerate. What the justice did with each.

pet-15198-01-de-sao-paulo-a-brasilia.s: An inquiry born of an anonymous PDF, a request to freeze R$ 5.7 billion, a judge who asks for explanations and a justice who pulls everything up to the Supreme Court. How the second phase of the operation changed address.

pet-15198-02-a-maquina-de-fundos.s: A clinic with R$ 54 thousand in revenue that issued R$ 361 million in notes. A bank that was the sole quotaholder of the funds buying the paper. What the police and the prosecutors say they found, in their own words.

pet-15198-03-a-madrugada-de-14-de-janeir.s: A flight to Dubai at 00:50, another to Curitiba at 07:30, a justice furious with the Federal Police and a temporary detention that lasted until seven in the morning. The second phase, hour by hour.

pet-15198-04-o-novo-relator-e-os-cem-apa.t: The new reporting justice and the hundred devices
pet-15198-04-o-novo-relator-e-os-cem-apa.s: In February the petition changes hands. The new justice writes about compartmentalisation quoting himself in Spanish, sends the forensic work back to the Federal Police, grants safe-conducts for the congressional inquiry and, in June, splits the investigation out of the drawer.

pet-15198-05-os-carros.s: An Aston Martin, a Bentley, two financed Porsches, thirteen registered guns and R$ 184,750 in cash. What the suspects asked to get back, what the State answered, and why the answer is always the same.

pet-15556-01-setenta-e-duas-horas.s: How a 164-page request from the Federal Police became, in five days, a 48-page ruling. What it is, what it is not, and why the prosecutors asked for more time and did not get it.

pet-15556-02-a-turma.s: A million a month, split six ways. What the ruling says about the surveillance and intimidation cell, in the words of the messages the police transcribed.

pet-15556-03-o-supervisor-que-revisava-o.t: The supervisor who reviewed the letter
pet-15556-03-o-supervisor-que-revisava-o.s: Two heads of the Central Bank department that supervised Master, a group chat, a consultancy for 'bringing young people into the financial market' and the sentence 'today we have to pay Belline's first one'.

pet-15556-04-o-que-o-ministro-decidiu-e-.t: What the justice decided, and how
pet-15556-04-o-que-o-ministro-decidiu-e-.s: The law requires three things to detain someone before trial. The ruling says it found all three, explains why, and then spends seven pages teaching how to make an arrest properly.

pet-15556-05-depois-do-decreto.s: From 4 March to 24 July 2026, in the same docket: a transfer to a federal penitentiary, a death, four safe-conducts, a father arguing over two billion and the securities regulator wanting to hear the detainee.

rcl-88121-01-a-pasta.s: In a search at a banker's home, the Federal Police collected a folder bearing a congressman's name. In the seizure report, the name vanished. The defence took that detail to the Supreme Court and, with it, the whole case. The reporting justice's first order was about the value of the claim.

rcl-88121-02-nove-de-dezembro.s: The injunction that suspended the Brasília investigation for all suspects, not only as regards the congressman; the order that the Central Bank comply with no one else's decision; and the week in which the INSS congressional inquiry, a social network and a bank searched by mistake all knocked on the same door.

rcl-88121-03-vinte-e-dois-de-dezembro.s: A São Paulo judge who refused to send Operation Quasar to the Supreme Court, a prosecutors' opinion that agreed with caution but defended the trial court, and the final decision: the Supreme Court keeps the case because, among everyone named, there is evidence against a single person with privileged venue.

rcl-88121-04-trinta-e-nove-bilhoes.s: The Central Bank answered the Supreme Court's order with a seven-page report and 58 attachments. In it is the arithmetic the press never closed: how much BRB bought from Master, how much it returned, what it received in exchange, and what the supervisor itself ordered provisioned.

rcl-88121-05-o-arquivo-que-nao-fecha.t: The file that will not close
rcl-88121-05-o-arquivo-que-nao-fecha.s: The complaint became final in February 2026 and was archived. After that it received a Central Bank leak to the federal audit court, a letter from the president of the INSS congressional inquiry, a new reporting justice, and a string of billion-real requests from BRB, from the Federal District and from a lawyer in another operation.
